status: published and verified; user style review pending
scope: Thirteen layered animated face presets in the selected Geraldine MIST style, with speech and transition review. New isolated pack; keep the live default until the new artwork is reviewed in motion.
nativeRasterPolicy: Preserve every selected native transparent PNG. Runtime may select atlas cells and align layers; do not repaint, stretch, rotate or synthesize new blink/viseme shapes in code.

mouthAtlas.dentalPolicy: TH uses the compact neutral articulation target; no tongue/tooth protrusion. A clear closure/release matters more than literal human mouth anatomy in this graphic style.

timing.speech: Use audible audio time. Merge nearby equivalent cues; protect closures. Silent gaps use the closed family rest; cancellation returns to the preset rest. Pause holds the current cue for frame inspection.

qualityGates: Native source hash and alpha verified
No detached fragments, rotated blink or tooth/tongue protrusions
All156 directed preset changes and mid-speech switches exercised
Silence, gaps, interruptions and repeated requests
speechLimit: Dictionary pronunciations fit to provider character-aligned word spans improve spelling-based targets. They remain estimated phone durations, not measured acoustic phoneme timestamps. Do not claim perfect alignment.
